items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: It’s by Zecharia Sitchin — S-I-T-C-H-I-N. It has to do with people coming from other planets.

ctx.x: I’ll have to look that one up.

Yeah. It’s by Zecharia Sitchin — S-I-T-C-H-I-N. It has to do with people coming from other planets. And, the gentleman who wrote it, like when he makes a statement, he shows you the writings and the Sumerian texts and things that substantiates what he says you see? The earth revolves 365 days of the year, the planet that these people come from, 3600 years revolve. That’s one year for them. So imagine that life span. So they were considered gods. And they, the Nephilims were the ones that created us. And the…
There was a “Twilight Zone” episode about that.
